reading.rtitle: Anna's Travel Diary -- Ten Days in Italy
paras: Last September I traveled to Italy with my sister. We arrived in Rome on a Sunday morning. The airport was very big and the taxi driver was friendly. We stayed in a small hotel near the old part of the city. The room was small, but the view was amazing.

On the first day we walked for six hours. We visited the old streets and we looked at the fountains. The weather was sunny and warm. In the afternoon we stopped at a small restaurant and we tried the pasta. It was delicious. In the evening I mailed a postcard to my mother.

The last two days were rainy, so we stayed in the hotel and we watched old movies. We arrived home three days ago. I am tired, but I am very happy. My best memory of the trip is the food and the people. They were kind and they talked to us every day.
reading.source: Anna's travel diary -- a message to her friend Marlene

listenings.text: Hi Marlene, this is Anna. I arrived home yesterday, and I want to tell you about the trip. We stayed in Italy for ten days. The first week was sunny and warm, so we walked in the old city every morning. On Thursday we visited a small town near Rome, and we tried a new dish in a family restaurant. It was delicious. The last two days were rainy, so we stayed in the hotel and we watched old movies. The people were very kind. My best memory is the food and the people. I mailed you a postcard from Rome. Call me this weekend, and I want to tell you the whole story.

Hello Marlene, this is David. Thank you for your message. I want to tell you about my last day in Istanbul. I started the day early, and the weather was rainy. So I stayed in the hotel and I watched a movie in my room. In the afternoon the weather changed, and it was sunny again. I walked to the old market with a friend. We looked at the carpets and we talked to the sellers. They were very friendly. I mailed a postcard to my sister, and then we tried a Turkish coffee. It was a perfect last day. My trip started two weeks ago, and now it is only an amazing memory. Have a good week.
